messages:
leah: Opening a PR to consolidate function/tool calling examples, streaming parse notes, and a short JSON-schema fallback snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4911 — can folks do a quick review?

mina: On it. I'll sweep the JS snippets and check for stale links.

omar: I'll rework the Python examples to use client.call_tool(...) and include a tiny pytest that demonstrates a fallback parse for streaming/token-split edge cases.

mina: +1. Also we should show a compact schema example using nullable + oneOf for action payloads so readers understand tolerant parsing. Example to include: `{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"oneOf":[{"type":"string","enum":["search","open","create"]},{"type":"null"}]}}}`

omar: Draft of the Python fallback snippet I'll add to the PR:
```python
# robust parse example (python)
try:
    payload = json.loads(resp_text)
except json.JSONDecodeError:
    # heuristic repair: trim stray bytes and try to re-parse
    repaired = try_repair_json(resp_text)
    payload = json.loads(repaired)
```

sophia: For the JS example, prefer `await redwood.callTool({ name, input })` and include an async-iterator streaming note. Show buffering before JSON.parse to avoid token-split failures.

docs-bot: link-checker ran on branch -> 2 broken example links detected. Comments posted on PR.

leah: Good catch. I'll replace the dead playground links and add a short "Streaming & parseability" note: 2 sentences about how partial tokens can break strict JSON parsing and recommended buffering strategy.

mina: Also add a short guardrail: use explicit enums for action discriminators and avoid freeform strings when callers need deterministic routing. One line + example test case.

omar: I'll open a tracking issue to translate these snippets to Private docs sections (VPC/on-prem) after merge.

leah: Plan: I'll push updates tonight, @sophia please run lint and snippet formatting check, @omar please sanity-check python tests. Targeting merge tomorrow morning. Any blockers?

sophia: No blockers. I'll follow up with a minor style tweak if needed.

mina: Sounds good. Thanks! :thumbsup:
